rationale.oversight-explanation: Token highlights help programmers locate and judge likely completion errors.
rationale.ai-review: A separate probabilistic edit model evaluates generated tokens for likely correction.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented an edit model and interactive highlighting prototype.
rationale.assistive: Programmers inspect and edit inline code completions at suggestion granularity.
rationale.risk-quality: The intervention targets correctness defects and measures unit-test performance.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focal analysis examines misplaced trust in absent or incomplete highlights.
rationale.method-self-report: Interviews and questionnaires captured preferences, workload, and perceived utility.
rationale.method-experiment: Thirty programmers completed controlled tasks under randomized highlighting conditions.
